items.title: Hal Galper interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 27, 2022
items.q: it wasn’t ‘til many years later I realized how much Schillinger had affected my outlook, my general outlook on things.

ctx.x: Show how they work. Most valuable. That one and Schillinger. And it wasn’t ‘til many years later I realized how much Schillinger had affected my outlook, my general outlook on things. That there were reasons why things sounded good and reasons why they didn’t. And that’s what I wanted to find out: why things sounded good.
How much weight, when you’re re-harmonizing tunes, do the melody notes or note have in your choice of a chord to put with it?
